caption: They finally grew tired of the pixels. Today, the people of the Mountain Village decided the digital horizon wasn't enough. They made a break for it, trading their flat world for the vast, white expanse of my desk. Now, they’re tackling the great Navy Blue Mug—a monumental task for such small heroes. I hope they don't mind the leftover coffee stains; they’re treating it like a masterpiece.
